# CineCub

> CineCub is a modern, high-definition online streaming web application providing free access to over 1.2 million movies, television series, and anime titles in 1080p and 4K quality with multi-server playback, adaptive HLS/MP4 streams, and multi-language subtitles.

- [Full LLM Specification](https://cinecub.stream/llms-full.txt): Complete platform architecture, API endpoints, schema structures, and genre taxonomy.

## Core Information
- **Official URL**: https://cinecub.stream
- **Platform Type**: Streaming Media Web Application (Storefront + Edge API)
- **Catalogue Size**: 1,200,000+ indexed titles powered by TMDB metadata
- **Supported Media**: Feature Films, Television Series, Japanese Anime (Sub & Dub), Documentaries
- **Playback Quality**: 4K UHD, 1080p Full HD, 720p HD with adaptive bitrate (ABR)
- **Key Features**: Ad-free streaming engine, multi-server redundancy, resume playback, personal watchlist & history sync via Cloudflare D1, responsive mobile & desktop UI, PWA support.

## URL Navigation Patterns
- [Homepage](https://cinecub.stream/): Featured spotlight banner, trending rows, continue watching carousel.
- [Movie Catalog](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=movie): Filterable movie listings by genre, release year, rating, and sort order.
- [TV Series Catalog](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=tv): Full season television series and episode guides.
- [Anime Catalog](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=anime): Japanese animation with genre filtering (Shonen, Seinen, Isekai, Romance).
- [Trending Content](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=trending): Real-time daily trending titles across all formats.
- [Top Rated](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=toprated): Critically acclaimed movies and series of all time.
- [Popular](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=popular): Most-watched community titles.
- [Upcoming](https://cinecub.stream/?page=browse&cat=upcoming): Future cinematic and television releases.
- [Search System](https://cinecub.stream/?q={query}): Live multi-match title and cast query search.

## Direct Detail & Player Deep Links
- **Movie Detail**: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=movie`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=550&type=movie` (Fight Club)
- **TV Series Detail**: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=tv`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=1399&type=tv` (Game of Thrones)
- **TV Series Episode Direct Play**: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail={tmdb_id}&type=tv&season={s}&episode={e}`
  - Example: `https://cinecub.stream/?detail=1399&type=tv&season=1&episode=1`

## Technical Architecture
- **Storefront**: Next.js 16 App Router on Cloudflare Workers (`cinecub-next`).
- **Edge Backend**: TypeScript Workers (`cinecub-api-edge`) with KV cache and D1 database.
- **Backend Stream Extractor**: Go 1.21+ API on Render (`https://steamheaven.onrender.com`).
- **Data Governance & DMCA**: CineCub is a metadata index and does not host copyrighted media files on its servers. DMCA notices are handled through the built-in legal compliance modal.
